h: CAF gives member associations a deadline to choose a 4-year or 2-year AFCON cycle
p: The Confederation of African Football has set a deadline for national associations to decide whether the Africa Cup of Nations should be held every two years or every four years. The outcome will shape the continental calendar for Nigeria and other nations.
more: The decision is expected to affect club-versus-country scheduling.
Associations are expected to vote after the deadline.
